extraction.name: LongVid
extraction.description: A large-scale long video instruction-tuning dataset comprising 114,228 long videos and 3,444,849 question-answering (QA) pairs across five different task types, supporting models to handle diverse long video scenarios. The dataset includes videos from Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-Vila, and MiraData, encompassing movies, egocentric videos, news, interviews, how-to videos, and other in-the-wild videos of long duration.
extraction.creator: Xinhao Li, Yi Wang, Jiashuo Yu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhan Zhu, Haian Huang, Jianfei Gao, Kunchang Li, Yinan He, Chenting Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Limin Wang
extraction.publisher: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nanjing University, Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Shanghai Innovation Institute
extraction.citeAs: Xinhao Li, Yi Wang, Jiashuo Yu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhan Zhu, Haian Huang, Jianfei Gao, Kunchang Li, Yinan He, Chenting Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Limin Wang. VideoChat-Flash: Hierarchical Compression for Long-Context Video Modeling. arXiv:2501.00574v4 [cs.CV], 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset leverages existing datasets including Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-Vila, and MiraData. Dense event labels are generated for each long video by utilizing existing high-quality short video captions and filtering consecutive segments that can be regrouped into a long video sequence. Event labels with corresponding timestamps are constructed based on captions.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Existing datasets: Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-Vila, and MiraData. High-quality short video captions from Panda-70M (for HD-VILA), CosMo (for HowTo100M), Ego4D-HCap (for Ego4D), and original captions from MiraData.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Consecutive segments from source datasets are filtered and regrouped into long video sequences. Event labels are extracted from captions using an LLM for datasets without high-quality event-level annotations.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Long videos are segmented and event labels with timestamps are constructed. Several types of long video QA pairs are constructed based on video captions, event labels, and timestamps of short video segments, categorized into five tasks: video captioning, temporal grounding, event relation recognition, scene relation recognition, and video event counting.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For datasets with high-quality event-level annotations (HT-Step for HowTo100M, Ego4D-HCap for Ego4D), these are directly utilized as event labels. For others, major events are extracted from captions using an LLM. Question-answering pairs are constructed based on video captions, event labels, and timestamps.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: LLM (Large Language Model) for extracting major events from captions
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: LLM used for extracting major events from captions
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The high compression ratio makes it difficult for such methods to achieve excellent long video understanding performance, and they may even be inferior to some MLLMs designed for image modeling
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training multimodal large language models for long video understanding tasks including video captioning, temporal grounding, event relation recognition, scene relation recognition, and video event counting. Used in multi-stage training strategy for instruction tuning.

name.evidence: To address this, we introduce a large-scale long video instruction-tuning dataset named LongVid.

description.evidence: It comprises 114,228 long videos and 3,444,849 question-answering (QA) pairs across five different task types, supporting models to handle diverse long video scenarios. To build LongVid, we leverages the rich diversity of existing datasets, including Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-Vila, and MiraData, encompassing a wide range of video types: movies, egocentric videos, news, interviews, and how-to videos, and other in-the-wild videos of long duration.

For data curation, we generate dense event labels for each long video. Specifically, we utilize existing high-quality short video captions (Panda-70M for HD-VILA, CosMo for HowTo100M, Ego4D-HCap for Ego4D, and the original high-quality captions provided in MiraData) and filter the consecutive segments that can be regroup into a long video sequence, then we construct a sequence of event labels with their corresponding timestamps for every long video based on their captions.
